sources.wyscout: Official Wyscout Open Data / Figshare collection 4415000
sources.wikidata: Official Wikidata MediaWiki API, WDQS discovery laboratory, and Special:EntityData Linked Data endpoint

methodology.team_resolution: Exact deterministic normalized club label plus football-club description; ambiguous club candidates fail closed
methodology.player_candidate_generation: Exact deterministic normalized Wyscout name variants, with known DOB contradictions excluded
methodology.crosswalk_rule: Wikidata profile evidence has no shared canonical match ids and therefore cannot become crosswalk_ready by itself
methodology.snapshot: Bounded immutable 50-QID snapshot with SHA-256 manifest verification

non_claims: This is not measured six-league Wikidata coverage.
No PlayerCrosswalk entries were created automatically.
No PostgreSQL or production evidence was written by this laboratory.
No performance metrics are supplied by this Wikidata profile path.
